analysis: objective compact panel selection from the 287-gene core
candidate_filter: 287-core member; NCBI protein-coding; label-blind feature presence on all five external platforms and GSE117606 FFPE
balance_rule: one adenoma-up plus one adenoma-down gene added at each step
path_objective: Pearson reconstruction of the complete 287-gene two-arm score
size_rule: Kneedle maximum normalized distance on the monotone envelope of the leave-one-donor-out Spearman fidelity curve; Satopaa et al., doi:10.1109/ICDCSW.2011.20
sensitivity_size_rule: smallest balanced pair count within one donor-bootstrap standard error of maximum leave-one-donor-out Spearman fidelity
